g.text: the definitions conflict, so choosing one is a values decision
when base rates differ, a model generally cannot
meet calibration and equal error rates at once
choosing a definition is a values decision, not technical
generative AI adds representational harms: stereotyped images,
unequal quality across languages, toxic outputs about groups.
test prompts across groups and languages, not just accuracy.
pick by the harm. In lending, unequal false rejections
often matter more, so error-rate parity is often the priority.
